cards.name: GraphicStyle
cards.summary: COM (type library) object for one graphic style from the Graphic Styles panel: a saved appearance (fills, strokes, effects, opacity) that can replace or be merged into the appearance of page items.
use_for: apply a house look (neon outline, sticker shadow) to many objects in one pass
brand-consistent button / badge styling across a batch of artboards
stacking a texture style on top of existing fills with MergeTo
avoid: creating a new style: the harvested collection has no Add, so build the style by hand once and reuse it
per-object tweaks: set fills/strokes on the item instead of forking styles
cards.how: Reached from a document's GraphicStyles collection over COM (Python win32com / VBScript), e.g. app.ActiveDocument.GraphicStyles.Item(2). The ExtendScript counterpart is ArtStyle, reached via app.activeDocument.graphicStyles. ApplyTo replaces an item's appearance with the style; MergeTo adds the style's attributes to what the item already has.

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: read / rename the style as it appears in the Graphic Styles panel

key_members.name: ApplyTo
key_members.use: replace the target item's appearance with this style

key_members.name: MergeTo
key_members.use: add this style's attributes on top of the item's current appearance

key_members.name: Delete
key_members.use: remove the style from the document's Graphic Styles panel

gotchas: COM uses Delete; the ExtendScript ArtStyle uses remove instead
the first style in the panel is normally the [Default] style, so real styles start at Item(2) (unverified)
applied to a group, the style lands on the group's own appearance, not on each child (unverified)
deleting a style does not strip the appearance from items already using it, they just lose the link (unverified)
cards.example:
import win32com.client
app = win32com.client.Dispatch('Illustrator.Application')
doc = app.ActiveDocument
style = doc.GraphicStyles.Item(2)
print(style.Name)
style.ApplyTo(doc.PageItems.Item(1))   # replace appearance
style.MergeTo(doc.PageItems.Item(2))   # add on top

review.changes: none

cards.name: GraphicStyles
cards.summary: COM collection of the document's graphic styles (the Graphic Styles panel contents): count, fetch, find the index of, or delete styles. It has no Add, so styles cannot be created through it.
use_for: list the styles a template ships with before a batch styling run
pick a named brand style and apply it to generated artwork
clean unused styles out of a delivered file
avoid: creating styles: no Add member exists; author the style in the UI or load a template document
ExtendScript: use the ArtStyles collection (app.activeDocument.graphicStyles) instead
cards.how: COM: app.ActiveDocument.GraphicStyles. Elements are GraphicStyle objects. COM collections are indexed through Item and counted with Count; COM indexing is 1-based while ExtendScript [i] is 0-based (unverified for this class).

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of styles in the document

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: get one GraphicStyle by position (or by name, unverified)

key_members.name: Index
key_members.use: position of a given GraphicStyle in the collection

key_members.name: Remove
key_members.use: delete one style from the document

gotchas: no Add member: scripts can only use or delete existing styles
RemoveAll probably keeps the [Default] style, which cannot be deleted (unverified)
Remove takes the GraphicStyle object, not its index
cards.example:
import win32com.client
doc = win32com.client.Dispatch('Illustrator.Application').ActiveDocument
styles = doc.GraphicStyles
for i in range(1, styles.Count + 1):
    print(i, styles.Item(i).Name)
print(styles.Index(styles.Item(styles.Count)))

review.changes: none

cards.name: TextFrames
cards.summary: COM collection of text frames in a document, layer or group, and the factory for new text: point text at an anchor, area text inside a path, or text on a path.
use_for: poster headline as point text at an exact position
body copy flowed into a shape (area text in a circle or panel)
badge or seal lettering running along a circular path
threading overflow text into a second frame
avoid: ExtendScript: the same job is document.textFrames (TextFrameItems) with pointText / areaText / pathText
outlining text for print: create the frame here, then convert it on the TextFrame, not via this collection
cards.how: COM: app.ActiveDocument.TextFrames (also on a Layer or GroupItem). Add makes a plain point text frame; PointText(Anchor) places point text at [x, y]; AreaText(TextPath) and PathText(TextPath) turn an existing PathItem into the frame shape or baseline. Optional BaseFrame + PostFix presumably thread the new frame to an existing one (unverified: the harvest gives only the parameter names). COM collections are indexed through Item and counted with Count; COM indexing is 1-based while ExtendScript [i] is 0-based (unverified for this class).

key_members.name: PointText
key_members.use: new point text frame at Anchor [x, y], optional Orientation

key_members.name: AreaText
key_members.use: new area text frame filling the given PathItem; BaseFrame/PostFix presumably thread it (unverified)

key_members.name: PathText
key_members.use: new text-on-path frame along the given PathItem, StartTValue/EndTValue limit the run

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: new point text frame with default placement

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of text frames in the container

key_members.name: RemoveAll
key_members.use: delete every text frame in the container

gotchas: AreaText and PathText consume the path: it becomes the frame's shape and loses its own fill and stroke (unverified)
Orientation is an optional variant taking the text orientation enum (horizontal / vertical); left out it presumably gives horizontal text (unverified)
coordinates are in points with y increasing upward, so positions below the artboard top are negative (unverified for non-default coordinate systems)
the new frame is empty: set its contents on the returned TextFrame
cards.example:
import win32com.client
doc = win32com.client.Dispatch('Illustrator.Application').ActiveDocument
frames = doc.TextFrames
head = frames.PointText([72, -120])
panel = doc.PathItems.Rectangle(-160, 72, 400, 300)
body = frames.AreaText(panel)
print(frames.Count)

review.changes: BaseFrame/PostFix threading and the Orientation default were stated as fact; marked unverified

cards.name: Asset
cards.path: Classes used for working with (exportable) assets in Adobe Illustrator/Asset
cards.summary: One exportable asset in the Asset Export panel: a piece of artwork registered for export, with a document-unique ID and an editable name; getNormalizedName gives a file-name-safe form of that name.
use_for: register icons or logo lockups for multi-size PNG/SVG export
rename assets so exported files follow a naming scheme
get a file-system-safe name for an asset before writing files
avoid: exporting whole artboards: use artboards with Export for Screens instead of assets
COM scripts: the COM object deletes with Delete, not remove
cards.how: ExtendScript: elements of app.activeDocument.assets (Assets collection), created with assets.add(art) or assets.addFromSelection(). Its assetID is what the document's Export for Screens call takes to export specific assets.

key_members.name: assetID
key_members.use: read-only ID, unique within the document; key used for export and lookup

key_members.name: assetName
key_members.use: asset name shown in the Asset Export panel (presumably the exported file name, unverified)

key_members.name: getNormalizedName
key_members.use: name stripped of special characters, safe as a file name

key_members.name: remove
key_members.use: delete this asset from the Asset Export panel

gotchas: over COM the delete call is Delete (harvested COM type has no remove / removeAll)
removeAll is listed on the single Asset object by the dictionary; what it removes is unclear, use remove (unverified)
removing the asset does not delete the artwork it points to (unverified)

review.changes: 'name used as the output file name' was unharvested; reworded to getNormalizedName and marked unverified

cards.name: GridRepeatConfig
cards.path: Classes used for working with Repeat art in Adobe Illustrator/GridRepeatConfig
cards.summary: Settings object for Object > Repeat > Grid artwork: horizontal and vertical spacing between tiles plus the shift/flip types that set the brick offset and mirrored rows or columns.
use_for: seamless backgrounds and wallpaper tiles from one motif
brick-offset pattern grids for packaging or textile mockups
mirrored tile grids (flipped rows or columns) for decorative borders
avoid: true pattern swatches for fills: a grid repeat is live artwork, not a Swatches pattern
editing gridConfig of an existing item in place: build a config and call setGridConfiguration
cards.how: ExtendScript: build one (the COM type library has a creatable GridRepeatConfig coclass; the ExtendScript constructor new GridRepeatConfig() is unverified), set its fields, pass it to doc.gridRepeatItems.add(art, config) or GridRepeatItem.setGridConfiguration. Read an existing item's values through its gridConfig.

key_members.name: horizontalSpacing
key_members.use: gap between tiles horizontally (the dictionary text says 'between each rows')

key_members.name: verticalSpacing
key_members.use: gap between tiles vertically (the dictionary text says 'between each columns')

key_members.name: patternType
key_members.use: grid shift type (RepeatGridShiftFlipType): plain grid or brick offset

gotchas: the harvested descriptions swap the axes (horizontal = 'between rows'); test the result before trusting either reading
spacing is presumably in points (unverified)
how each RepeatGridShiftFlipType value maps to the Grid / Brick by Row / Brick by Column choices in the UI is not confirmed (unverified)
COM adds ObjectValue and Application members that ExtendScript does not have
the COM type library states the defaults: horizontal and vertical spacing 10.0, patternType / rowFlipType / columnFlipType NoSF (no shift or flip)

review.changes: added the harvested COM defaults (10.0 / NoSF); example comment flags the unverified constructor

cards.name: GridRepeatItem
cards.path: Classes used for working with Repeat art in Adobe Illustrator/GridRepeatItem
cards.summary: A live Grid repeat object (Object > Repeat > Grid) on the page: the source art tiled in rows and columns, still editable; a PageItem subclass that carries its grid settings.
use_for: tiled backgrounds that update when the motif is edited
changing the spacing of an existing repeat across many files in batch
duplicating or moving a repeat block between layers
avoid: final hand-off to apps that do not know Repeat art: expand it first in the UI
fill patterns: use a pattern swatch when the tile must fill arbitrary shapes
cards.how: ExtendScript: element of doc.gridRepeatItems (also on layers and groups), created by gridRepeatItems.add(sourceArt, config). It inherits PageItem, so position, size and transform members come from PageItem. Read settings from gridConfig; change them with setGridConfiguration(config, state).

key_members.name: gridConfig
key_members.use: read-only GridRepeatConfig with the current spacing and flip settings

key_members.name: setGridConfiguration
key_members.use: apply a GridRepeatConfig; state is a GridRepeatUpdate flag saying which properties changed

key_members.name: duplicate
key_members.use: copy the repeat item relative to another object

key_members.name: move
key_members.use: move it relative to another object (ElementPlacement)

gotchas: gridConfig is read-only; assigning to its fields may not rebuild the art, so call setGridConfiguration (unverified)
state is a bit-flag of the GridRepeatUpdate enum; passing a flag that does not cover the field you changed may leave it unchanged (unverified)
over COM the item deletes with Delete (no remove / removeAll) and also has Cut, Copy and hidden MoveToBeginning / MoveToEnd / MoveBefore / MoveAfter; those are extra moves, not delete calls
state values come from the harvested enum GridRepeatUpdate (enum:GridRepeatUpdate); it also has an *ALL value that updates every property

review.changes: example passed an undefined `flags` and would throw; now passes GridRepeatUpdate.GRIDALL (harvested enum:GridRepeatUpdate); COM gotcha implied Cut/Copy/MoveTo* replace remove; reworded

cards.name: RadialRepeatConfig
cards.path: Classes used for working with Repeat art in Adobe Illustrator/RadialRepeatConfig
cards.summary: Settings object for Object > Repeat > Radial artwork: how many copies go around the circle, the circle radius, and whether the overlap order is reversed.
use_for: mandala, flower and sunburst motifs from one petal
clock faces, dial ticks and badge rims
radial logo marks with an exact copy count
avoid: copies along an arbitrary path: use a pattern brush or blend instead
a static result for other apps: expand the repeat after setting it
cards.how: ExtendScript: build one (COM has a creatable RadialRepeatConfig coclass; the ExtendScript constructor new RadialRepeatConfig() is unverified), set the fields, then pass it to doc.radialRepeatItems.add(art, config) or RadialRepeatItem.setRadialConfiguration.

key_members.name: radius
key_members.use: radius of the ring the copies sit on

key_members.name: reverseOverlap
key_members.use: true reverses the overlap (stacking) order of the copies

gotchas: radius is presumably in points (unverified)
no start-angle field is exposed here; rotate the resulting item instead (unverified that the UI angle is absent from scripting)
COM adds ObjectValue and Application members that ExtendScript does not have
the COM type library states the defaults: numberOfInstances 8, reverseOverlap false, radius -1.0 (what -1 means is not stated; presumably 'derive from the art', unverified)

review.changes: reverseOverlap 'last copy tucks under the first' was invented detail, reworded; added harvested COM defaults (8 / false / -1.0); example comment flags the constructor

cards.name: SymmetryRepeatConfig
cards.path: Classes used for working with Repeat art in Adobe Illustrator/SymmetryRepeatConfig
cards.summary: Settings object for Object > Repeat > Mirror artwork: one value, the angle of the mirror axis, given in radians counter-clockwise from the x-axis.
use_for: symmetric logos, crests and emblems drawn from one half
mirrored ornaments on a tilted axis
face or butterfly style symmetric illustration setups
avoid: a one-off flip: Reflect is simpler when nothing needs to stay live
degree values: convert to radians first
cards.how: ExtendScript: build one (COM has a creatable SymmetryRepeatConfig coclass; ExtendScript new SymmetryRepeatConfig() is unverified), set axisRotationAngleInRadians, then pass it to doc.symmetryRepeatItems.add(art, config) or SymmetryRepeatItem.setSymmetryConfiguration.

key_members.name: axisRotationAngleInRadians
key_members.use: mirror axis angle in radians, counter-clockwise from the x-axis

gotchas: the angle is in radians: 90 degrees is Math.PI / 2
COM adds ObjectValue and Application members that ExtendScript does not have
the COM type library states a default axis of 1.57 rad (about Math.PI / 2, a vertical mirror axis)

review.changes: added the harvested COM default 1.57 rad; example comment flags the constructor

cards.name: SymmetryRepeatItem

cards.summary: A live Mirror repeat object (Object > Repeat > Mirror): the source art plus its live reflection across an axis; a PageItem subclass that carries its axis setting.

re-angling the mirror axis of existing symmetric art in batch
duplicating a mirrored ornament across a layout
avoid: a static mirrored copy for export: expand it or use Reflect
multi-axis kaleidoscope looks: combine with a radial repeat instead

key_members.name: duplicate

key_members.name: move
key_members.use: move it relative to another object

the axis angle is in radians

cards.name: Artboards
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection of a document's artboards: add, insert and delete artboards, find one by name, and read or set which artboard is active.
use_for: build a multi-size social set (square post, portrait post, story) in one document
pick the active artboard before an export or fit command
count how many artboards the user selected in the Artboards panel
avoid: resizing an existing artboard: change the Artboard's own rectangle rather than delete and re-add
page-style layouts with master pages: Illustrator artboards have no masters
cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument.artboards; elements are Artboard objects, indexed from 0. add(rect) and insert(rect, index) take an artboard rectangle [left, top, right, bottom] in points.

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: append a new artboard with the given rectangle, returns the Artboard

key_members.name: insert
key_members.use: add an artboard at a given index

key_members.name: remove
key_members.use: delete the artboard at an index (takes an index, not the object)

key_members.name: setActiveArtboardIndex
key_members.use: make an artboard current (affects later artboard-relative commands)

key_members.name: getNumSelectedArtboard
key_members.use: how many artboards are selected in the Artboards panel

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete all artboards (a document needs at least one, unverified)

gotchas: the rectangle is [left, top, right, bottom] with y increasing upward, so bottom is lower than top (unverified for non-default coordinate systems)
remove takes an index (harvested signature remove(index:Int32)), not the Artboard object
the dictionary lists getByName twice (name and artboardName); both find the first match
COM has Count / Item / Index instead of length and [i] (harvested COM diff)
the last artboard cannot be removed (unverified)

review.changes: equivalents.CDR 'Pages' also matches a CDR menu item; pinned to API id class:Pages; use_for listed pixel sizes not in the batch; reworded without numbers

cards.name: ArtStyles
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection behind document.graphicStyles: the graphic styles saved in the document. Read, count, find by name or clear; it has no add.
use_for: find a named brand style before applying it to generated art
audit the styles a template carries
strip all styles from a hand-off file
avoid: creating styles: there is no add member, author them in the UI
COM scripts: use the GraphicStyles collection instead
cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument.graphicStyles returns this ArtStyles collection; elements are ArtStyle objects (apply or merge them onto page items, see the ArtStyle card).

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: first style with this exact name

gotchas: the property is called graphicStyles but its type is ArtStyles; searching the docs for 'GraphicStyles' finds the COM class
getByName throws when no style has the name, so wrap it in try / catch (unverified)
no single-item remove on the collection; remove styles through the ArtStyle element

review.changes: none

cards.name: Assets
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection of the document's exportable assets (Asset Export panel): add artwork as assets, look them up by name or ID, and delete them.
use_for: register every icon on an icon sheet for one-click multi-format export
build an export manifest from asset names and IDs
clear stale assets before a re-export
avoid: exporting full artboards: use artboards with Export for Screens
deleting by index: remove takes an assetID
cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument.assets. add(art) registers given art (a page item or array) and addFromSelection() registers the current selection; both return an Asset.

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: create an asset from the given art

key_members.name: addFromSelection
key_members.use: create an asset from the selected art

key_members.name: remove
key_members.use: delete the asset with this assetID

gotchas: remove takes an assetID number, not an index or an Asset (harvested signature remove(assetID:Int32))
addFromSelection needs a non-empty selection (unverified error text)
getByName is listed twice (name and assetName); both return the first match
COM has Count / Item / Index instead of length and [i]

review.changes: none

cards.name: Brushes
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection of the brushes in the document's Brushes panel; it reads brushes by index or name and has add / addAndLoad methods that take a brush-definition File. What file format those accept is not stated in the harvest.
use_for: find a named calligraphic, art or pattern brush to apply to generated paths
check a template carries the brushes a script expects
load a brush from a definition file (format unconfirmed) and arm the Paintbrush tool with it
avoid: deleting brushes: the collection has no remove / removeAll
COM scripts: COM has no GetByName for brushes, loop over Item instead
cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument.brushes; elements are Brush objects (apply one to a path, see the Brush card). add(brushDefinition, brushName) creates a brush from a File; addAndLoad(brushDefinition) also selects the brush tool and loads the new brush into it.

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: create a brush from a brush-definition File, optional name

key_members.name: addAndLoad
key_members.use: create a brush from a File, switch to the brush tool and load it

gotchas: what file add / addAndLoad expect is not in the harvest; test with a real file before relying on it (unverified)
addAndLoad changes the active tool, a UI side effect in an unattended run
the [Basic] entry may be counted in length (unverified)
no remove members: brushes can only be added or read here
over COM, Add and AddAndLoad take BrushDefinition as a string, not a File object (harvested COM signature)

review.changes: added the COM signature difference (BrushDefinition is a string over COM, File in ExtendScript)

cards.name: Characters
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection of single characters in a text frame, story or text range; each element is a one-character TextRange. It also appends text with add / addBefore.
use_for: per-letter colour or size for playful display type
drop-cap style first-letter styling
counting characters to fit a headline into a layout
avoid: styling long runs letter by letter: style a whole TextRange or paragraph instead (much faster)
word or line operations: use the words, lines or paragraphs collections
cards.how: ExtendScript: textFrame.characters, story.characters or textRange.characters. characters[i] is a TextRange covering one character; add(contents) creates characters from a string.

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: add characters from a string, returns the new TextRange

key_members.name: addBefore
key_members.use: add characters before the range (unverified exact position)

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete all characters in the range

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: inherited lookup by name, not meaningful for characters (unverified)

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: owning text frame, story or range

gotchas: looping over thousands of characters is slow; batch attribute changes on larger ranges (unverified timing)
no single-character remove in ExtendScript; COM has a hidden Remove(item), and COM Add also takes optional RelativeObject / InsertionLocation arguments
a paragraph break counts as a character (unverified)

review.changes: COM Remove is hidden in the type library and COM Add has two extra optional args; gotcha corrected

cards.name: CharacterStyles
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection of the document's character styles (Character Styles panel): create a named style, find one by name, count or clear them.
use_for: set up a house type system (price, highlight, footnote styles) in a template by script
find a character style to apply to text runs in data-merged layouts
audit styles before hand-off
avoid: paragraph-level settings like alignment or indents: use ParagraphStyles
one-off formatting: set attributes on the TextRange directly
cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument.characterStyles (textRange.characterStyles gives the styles applied to a range). add(name) returns a new CharacterStyle; set its character attributes and apply it to text ranges through that object.
gotchas: add with a name that already exists throws (unverified)
[Normal Character Style] sits at index 0 and survives removeAll (unverified)
over COM, Count / Item / Index stand in for length / [i], there is no GetByName, and Remove(item) exists but is hidden in the type library (harvested COM diff)

review.changes: COM gotcha said Remove replaces ExtendScript names; corrected to the real diff (hidden Remove, no GetByName)

cards.name: CompoundPathItems
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection of compound paths (several paths that act as one shape, overlaps punching holes) in a document, layer or group; add() creates an empty compound path to fill with paths.
use_for: donut, ring and frame shapes with real holes
letterform-like icons with counters
knock-out stencil shapes for cutting or vinyl
avoid: simply grouping shapes: a group keeps each path's own fill
boolean merges that should become one outline: use Pathfinder instead
cards.how: ExtendScript: doc.compoundPathItems (also layer / group). add() returns an empty CompoundPathItem; create paths inside it through its own pathItems collection, or move existing paths into it.

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: first compound path with this name

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: delete all compound paths in the container

gotchas: an empty compound path left in the file is an invisible stray object; always put paths in it
whether an inner shape becomes a hole depends on path direction; pass reversed = true on the inner shape if it fills in (unverified)
doc.compoundPathItems may include compound paths nested in groups (unverified)

review.changes: none

cards.name: DataSets
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection of the data sets in the Variables panel: snapshots of variable values used for data-driven graphics (one set per record).
use_for: batch name badges, price tags or certificates from a data table
flip a template through records to export one file per record
capture the current variable values as a new record
avoid: documents without variables: bind variables first, data sets only store their values
large mail-merge jobs: driving text directly from a CSV in script is often simpler

key_members.name: add

key_members.name: getByName
key_members.use: first data set with this name

add() captures values at call time; edit the art first, then add (unverified)
over COM, Count / Item / Index stand in for length / [i], there is no GetByName, and Remove(item) exists but is hidden in the type library (harvested COM diff)

cards.name: Documents
cards.summary: ExtendScript collection of open Illustrator documents: create new ones (plain, from a preset, or with the New Document dialog), find one by name, and arrange the document windows.
